verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no query-suggestions feature, either derived from real search traffic or served from a dedicated suggestions index. The facet search endpoint offers type-ahead only over facet values in filter menus, which is a related but different feature from query suggestions. Analytics tracks search queries but is never described as feeding suggestions, and one community user explicitly said they miss a typeahead feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve query suggestions and autocomplete backed by real search traffic or a suggestions index
